headline: Sparkling adaptogen drinks with supply chain transparency.
body: Enjoy a hangover-free functional cocktail alternative with complete supply chain transparency. Feel good with crisp sparkling adaptogens crafted for your body.
rationale: This Sustainability Buyer values concrete evidence over buzzwords. By highlighting supply chain transparency directly and framing the non-alcoholic adaptogenic sparkling drink as a clean functional cocktail alternative, the ad addresses her desire for clear sourcing without resorting to vague eco claims.
